sections.title: Lock-in by a thousand calls
body: Provider SDK calls spread through components, hooks and server code. Switching later means touching all of them.

sections.title: One API, swappable backends
body: Kavach puts each platform behind an adapter. Supabase covers auth, data, storage and logging; Firebase, Auth0, AWS Amplify and Convex cover auth today.

sections.title: Decide later, change cheaply
body: Start with what you know, and keep the option to move. Your routes, rules and UI do not change when the adapter does.
